# proxmox_sdn_subnets (Data Source)

Lists staged subnets of one SDN VNet, sorted by `subnet`. Requires `vnet` because subnets are only addressable per VNet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_subnets" "vnet1" {
  vnet = proxmox_sdn_vnet.app.vnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) VNet whose subnets are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Matching subnets, sorted by `subnet`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `state` (String)
- `subnet` (String)
- `vnet` (String)
